JOB_LEDGER.sql:
SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, 'contract' AS entry_type, p.contract_value_gbp AS amount_gbp
FROM fixit.site.projects p WHERE p.status <> 'cancelled'
UNION ALL
SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, 'labour', -SUM(w.hours * c.hourly_rate_gbp)
FROM fixit.site.work_logs w JOIN fixit.site.crew c ON c.crew_id = w.crew_id JOIN fixit.site.projects p ON p.project_id = w.project_id
WHERE p.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name
UNION ALL
SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, 'materials', -SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_cost_gbp)
FROM fixit.site.material_orders o JOIN fixit.site.projects p ON p.project_id = o.project_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND p.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name

WORK_COST.sql:
SELECT w.log_id, w.project_id, w.work_date, w.task_type, c.crew_name, c.crew_type, w.hours,
       w.hours * c.hourly_rate_gbp AS cost_gbp
FROM fixit.site.work_logs w JOIN fixit.site.crew c ON c.crew_id = w.crew_id

DELIVERED_MATERIALS.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.project_id, o.material, o.supplier, o.order_date,
       o.quantity * o.unit_cost_gbp AS delivered_value_gbp, o.wasted_quantity * o.unit_cost_gbp AS wasted_value_gbp
FROM fixit.site.material_orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

JOBS.sql:
SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.project_type, p.actual_end_date,
       CASE WHEN p.actual_end_date > p.planned_end_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery
FROM fixit.site.projects p WHERE p.status = 'complete'
